LanguageData.IRC_EnableHumanRaidsDesc: Conservatively replaces pairs of low-tier raiders with a stronger vanilla pawn kind from the same faction group. No combat stat buffs are added.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableMechanoidRaidsDesc: Promotes mechanoid models within the same vanilla group while preserving breachers and excluding mech bosses as budget fillers.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableManhunterPacksDesc: Prefers a stronger local species, then falls back to a manhunter-eligible migrating animal from Core or an official DLC. No stat buffs are added.
LanguageData.IRC_VerboseLoggingDesc: Writes the original and compressed pawn counts and costs to the game log.
LanguageData.IRC_HistoryExplanation: This page shows each successful compression or safe fallback during the current game session. Records are not written to the save.
LanguageData.IRC_HistoryEmpty: No eligible threats have been evaluated in this session.
LanguageData.IRC_HistoryNumbers: Count {0} → {1} Kind cost {2} → {3} Retained {4}% Event budget {5} Game tick {6}
LanguageData.IRC_ReasonNoPromotion: No promotion in the active vanilla group satisfies the role, cost, and count restrictions.
LanguageData.IRC_ReasonNoAnimal: No higher-value manhunter species from Core or an official DLC is legal under the current conditions.
